parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can contain only ASCII characters. The token can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

Modify: temporarily upgrades specifications.
Add: temporarily adds nodes
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型。取值：

Modify：临时升配
Add：临时加节点
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The change type. The value is fixed as TempUpgrade
parameters.help_zh: 变更类型。当前取值固定为TempUpgrade
parameters.name: modify_type

fields.help_en:
The specifications of the node to be upgraded or added.

When you add a node, the node specifications must be the same as those of the existing nodes.
For the specifications of existing cluster nodes, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html
fields.help_zh:
升配/新增节点的规格。

新增节点时，节点规格需要与原有节点规格保持一致。
原有集群节点规格请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html
fields.name: target_class

fields.help_en: The zone of the node to be added. The zone must be the same as that of the existing nodes
fields.help_zh: 新增节点的可用区。需要与原有节点保持一致
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The information about the node to be upgraded or added
parameters.name: db_node

parameters.help_en:
The restore time for the temporary upgrade. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss format.

The restore time cannot be earlier than 1 hour after the current time or later than 1 day before the cluster expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
临时升配还原时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss。

还原时间不能早于当前时间往后推1小时，不能晚于集群到期时间的前1天
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true (default): Uses coupons.
false: Does not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：使用优惠券。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If this parameter is not specified, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
parameters.name: promotion_code

items.description_en:
The list of nodes.

If OperationType is set to Add, this parameter returns a non-empty value. If OperationType is set to Modify, this parameter returns an empty value
items.description_zh:
节点列表。

当OperationType取值为Add时，该参数返回值不为空；当OperationType取值为Modify时，该参数返回值为空
